svg.title: Genmitsu 3018-PROVer V2 retrofit individual-conductor retrofit diagram
svg.desc: Exact controller, interface, driver, supply and machine terminal labels are joined by separate conductors. Dotted routes are proposed unverified guesses. OPEN breaks identify the missing connection. Numbering is logical, not a mating-face view.

text.tspan: Genmitsu 3018-PROVer V2 retrofit · individual conductor plan

svg.text: Dotted = GUESS / proposed conversion, verify before energizing · Green = retained source path · Broken = OPEN
Each circle is one named physical pin, terminal or identified lead. Connector orientation and fitted revision must match.
Crossing lines are not junctions. Connections exist only at the named terminal circles and explicitly shared nets.

text.tspan: Smoothieboard V2 Core supply inlet: P1 J42

svg.text: Connector nets are from the exported Core P1 PCB contacts. Supply voltage limits and machine PSU suitability must be checked
against the actual board revision before connection.

text.tspan: X motor: integrated Prime phase outputs

svg.text: Source establishes Prime output net names. Machine lead order and phase pairing are unknown; identify coils with power
isolated.

text.tspan: Y motor: integrated Prime phase outputs

svg.text: Source establishes Prime output net names. Machine lead order and phase pairing are unknown; identify coils with power
isolated.

text.tspan: Z motor: integrated Prime phase outputs

svg.text: Source establishes Prime output net names. Machine lead order and phase pairing are unknown; identify coils with power
isolated.

text.tspan: Core X external driver: SN74LVC07A → DM320T PUL/DIR

svg.text: One SN74LVC07A per axis; DM320T P1 optocouplers are supplied by the +5V node in the dedicated opto panel. Each loaded sink
draws 7–16mA; only two of six gates are used on this IC (14–32mA total estimated, never assume nameplate motor colour).
Connect 100nF between pin14 VCC and pin7 GND at the IC. Verify Core J5 signal/return contacts and scope signals before driver
enable. DM320T P1 also has ENA; manufacturer manual states it is enabled by default when left unconnected. It is
intentionally open here; E-stop must remove hazardous power independently.

text.tspan: X DM320T P2 motor phase outputs

svg.text: DM320T P2 A+/A-/B+/B- are motor phase outputs. Identify machine winding pairs with continuity and never connect these
terminals to controller STEP/DIR.

text.tspan: Core Y external driver: SN74LVC07A → DM320T PUL/DIR

svg.text: One SN74LVC07A per axis; DM320T P1 optocouplers are supplied by the +5V node in the dedicated opto panel. Each loaded sink
draws 7–16mA; only two of six gates are used on this IC (14–32mA total estimated, never assume nameplate motor colour).
Connect 100nF between pin14 VCC and pin7 GND at the IC. Verify Core J5 signal/return contacts and scope signals before driver
enable. DM320T P1 also has ENA; manufacturer manual states it is enabled by default when left unconnected. It is
intentionally open here; E-stop must remove hazardous power independently.

text.tspan: Y DM320T P2 motor phase outputs

svg.text: DM320T P2 A+/A-/B+/B- are motor phase outputs. Identify machine winding pairs with continuity and never connect these
terminals to controller STEP/DIR.

text.tspan: Core Z external driver: SN74LVC07A → DM320T PUL/DIR

svg.text: One SN74LVC07A per axis; DM320T P1 optocouplers are supplied by the +5V node in the dedicated opto panel. Each loaded sink
draws 7–16mA; only two of six gates are used on this IC (14–32mA total estimated, never assume nameplate motor colour).
Connect 100nF between pin14 VCC and pin7 GND at the IC. Verify Core J5 signal/return contacts and scope signals before driver
enable. DM320T P1 also has ENA; manufacturer manual states it is enabled by default when left unconnected. It is
intentionally open here; E-stop must remove hazardous power independently.

text.tspan: Z DM320T P2 motor phase outputs

svg.text: DM320T P2 A+/A-/B+/B- are motor phase outputs. Identify machine winding pairs with continuity and never connect these
terminals to controller STEP/DIR.

text.tspan: Core external driver power: three fused DM320T P2 branches

svg.text: DM320T P2 +Vdc/GND is the 10-30V motor-power input. Connect each drive as a separately fused branch. Select supply capacity
and current setting only after measuring actual motor and full system loads.

text.tspan: Core external-driver P1 opto supplies and signal return

svg.text: The DM320T manual specifies P1 OPTO at typical +5V for common-anode input wiring. Feed each OPTO from regulated 5V. The TI
SN74LVC07A open-drain outputs sink PUL/DIR current; its VCC is Core 3.3V and its ground return is the Core signal reference.
Check regulator/output current and isolation boundaries.

text.tspan: 775 spindle controller: PWM, direction and motor output

svg.text: Core J35.6 exports TIM1_CH1 (PWM candidate) and J35.10 GND. Cytron MD10C R3.0 has PWM, DIR, GND, VM, PWR_GND, OUT_A/B; manual
Rev3.0 V1.0 Aug 2018 supports sign-magnitude PWM+DIR and 3.3/5V logic. DIR tied to logic GND selects Forward while PWM is
high per the manual truth table; bench-check actual spindle rotation and ensure PWM low stops/brakes as expected. Separate
motor supply must match measured motor voltage/current and be fused. Do not use guessed red/black wiring.
Do not assume the original 24 V / 4 A adapter is sufficient for controller, axes and spindle together. MD10C source says no
overcurrent protection.
Prime source pin schedule: J24-J29 pin2 GND, pin3 input, pin1 selector. This candidate J-to-axis/end assignment is not
established by Genmitsu manual; trace each harness and test switch state first.

established by Genmitsu manual; trace each harness and test switch state first.

text.tspan: Prime alternative · separate logic and motor supplies

svg.text: This is the alternative integrated-driver architecture. The same PCB-derived contact labels occur on P11/P12, but driver
type, rating and current configuration differ. Use one verified power-entry arrangement; J10 parallels VMOT and is left
unused here. Board ground is shared internally; route motor current directly to power distribution, not through logic wiring.
Determine actual allowed voltage/current before choosing a supply; no machine-source adapter automatically qualifies.
Read the exact per-wire schedule, full contact inventory, parts, configuration and source checks in the accompanying profile.
